Package dev.px.core.render.font

Class FontService

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.render.font.FontService
All Implemented Interfaces:
Named, Service
public final class FontService extends Object implements Service
The fonts the client draws with, addressed by name.

Loading a font is backend and version specific, so that work belongs to a FontProvider the adapter installs. Core only keeps the handles and decides which one is the default, which is what lets a HUD element ask for "title" without knowing whether that came from a TTF, the game font, or a system typeface.
